Priya (Sales): FYI - GlobalCapital wants a sealed on‑prem POC. No outbound egress allowed. Asks: signed bundles, SBOM, monthly patches, emergency USB hotfix workflow, HSM attest. Need SOW language + per‑patch pricing.
Jordan (Solutions): We can deliver minibundles (operator + runtime deltas). Two delivery modes: monthly deltas or quarterly full + monthly deltas. Default USB-friendly delta cap = 1.5GB. Larger payloads -> chunked bundle.
Ravi (Security): Requirements: SPDX SBOM with each bundle, detached signatures (can accept customer-signed or Redwood-signed), offline verification tool, and key custody proof. If Redwood holds keys they will ask for attestation and rotation policy.
Ethan (Eng): Offline verification binary verifies SHA256 manifests and detached sig. Will also check SBOM hashes. Works without network. Well supply manifest schema and example verification command. Note: applying delta requires previous KV cache to be present or else we fall back to cold restart.
artifact-bot: Uploaded staged artifact: artifacts/offline/1743219999/gcap-sealed-v1.tar.gz SHA256=3a7d9f...
Carmen (Ops): Ops SOW notes: maintenance window estimate 60-90 mins for delta apply; retention of last 3 bundles on node; rollback preserved 72 hours. Emergency hotfix SLA standard 72h, expedited 24h add-on. Customer must provide transfer media and transport SOP.
Priya (Sales): Legal/Q: they want firm per-patch line item and a clause that guarantees monthly security patches. Draft suggestion: "Redwood will provide monthly security patches; feature rollouts quartery; emergency fixes per SLA." Good?
Ravi (Security): Fine. Add: "Customer responsible for offline transport and media security; Redwood provides signed artifacts and verification tooling." Flag: FIPS-only signing request will trigger a 2-3 week compliance check.
Jordan (Solutions): Pricing items to propose: 1) One-time sealed-bundle engineering fee, 2) Per-patch handling & signing fee, 3) Emergency hotfix premium, 4) Optional HSM/KMS on-site integration professional services.
Ethan (Eng): Note on HSM: for fully air-gapped KMS we support local PKCS#11 HSM for runtime unwraps, but initial bootstrap requires ops assistance. Include as PSA in SOW.
Priya (Sales): Action items: Jordan -> draft SOW pricing lines; Ravi -> fill sec questionnaire sections & attach SBOM template; Ethan -> deliver manifest + verifier binary; Carmen -> ops runbook snippet (apply/verify/rollback). Ill confirm USB size limit with customer. :thumbsup:
